$comment: Single source of truth for everything this package DERIVES. scripts/generate-artifacts.mjs reads this file and rebuilds the derived artifacts; --check fails CI when a derived file has drifted. Anything not listed here is hand-written and must not be regenerated.

config.$comment: The plugin's config surface, mirrored into cordis.patch.yml as the row's `config:`. Key order is stable so generated diffs stay readable. Only genuinely optional behaviour is here: the section order is fixed and the catalog is read once at activation, so neither is a knob.

description.skills: Register the skills catalog. false = bootstrap only.
description.bootstrap: Inject the using-superpowers bootstrap into the system prompt.
description.toolMapping: Append the dsh tool mapping to the bootstrap.
description.providerName: Provider label recorded on every skill registered with ctx.skills.
description.skillsDir: Skills root. Empty = resolve automatically: config → SUPERPOWERS_SKILLS_DIR → <package>/skills → <package>/../skills.

copies.$comment: Files that must exist inside skills/ but cannot simply live there: the master copy is kept elsewhere and re-materialised after a sync, because a sync rebuilds the upstream-owned directories around it. Anything NOT listed here lives natively in skills/ and needs no copying.

regions.$comment: Generated regions inside hand-written files, delimited by marker comments. The generator replaces only the text between markers.

skillTree.$comment: Where skills live. `root` is the vendored upstream tree, rebuilt wholesale by every sync. `own` names skills this package authors *inside* that tree; it is deliberately empty, because the two maintenance skills live in `.agents/skills/` instead — dsh scans that as the project scope for contributors working in this repository, and `package.json#files` ships no `.agents/`, so users of the published package never see them.
